diagnosis: The long-polling endpoint subscribes to real-time status updates on transferId over Redis without checking if req.user.id is the initiator or recipient of the wire transfer. An attacker can monitor payment processing stages and recipient account details of wire transfers initiated by other customers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/transfers/tx_wire_9921804/poll-status HTTP/1.1
Host: api.globalbanking.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
